canonical_name: Talagrand concentration family for convex Lipschitz functions
category: 组合数学 / 计数组合
candidate_family_not_credited_as_stateme: A convex Lipschitz real-valued function of independent bounded coordinates has Gaussian-type concentration around a median, with the precise support, norm, center, tail directions, constants, and source derivation still open.
statement_blocker: The catalog supplies only 'concentration of convex Lipschitz functions'. It fixes no coordinate spaces or laws, product and support assumptions, ambient norm, convexity domain, Lipschitz constant, measurability, center, tail event, constants, quantifier order, or boundary cases. The inspected 1995 primary paper proves set-fattening and convex-distance inequalities and explicitly gives no abstract functional statement; later functional attributions jointly cite 1995 and 1996 sources. Selecting a formula at intake would invent or substitute mathematics.
